describe.description: A large bird of prey shown in strict right-facing profile against a plain light background. The head, neck, torso, wings and legs are those of a brown eagle with dense, layered brown plumage, a hooked beak and scaly yellow feet with black talons. The wings are folded along the sides of the body. The feathered tail is absent and in its place a cluster of thick, fleshy, sucker-lined tentacles hangs vertically from the rear beneath the wing tips, curling at the tips. The upper legs/thighs also show pale circular sucker-like patterning on the skin beneath the feathers. The overall impression is a single upright standing animal with an eagle front and octopus-like rear.
